The theorems are not vacuous: squashed entanglement satisfies the hypotheses.

findings.title: Form of asymptotic continuity
findings.text: Eq. (13) is linear in the trace norm, K‖ρ−σ‖₁ log2 d + f. The bound available for squashed entanglement from the cited route (Alicki–Fannes; Christandl's thesis, Cor. 4.16) is 16√(2ε) log d + 4h(2√(2ε)), which is not of that form. GB9–GB10 prove Theorem 2 for any modulus g(ε) log2 d + f(ε) with g, f → 0, so the theorem holds for E_sq; the premise node ax-ac is stated in that weaker form.

findings.title: Monotonicity is a premise of Theorem 1
findings.text: The statement lists 'additive and finite'; the SMT minimality test shows LOCC monotonicity is also needed for the 'only if' direction (it is implied by 'entanglement measure' in the text). Eq. (21) uses f(ε) for a distance < ε, which needs f nondecreasing (or its monotone envelope).

findings.title: What each direction uses
findings.text: Achievability (GB2, GB6) is a relabelling of system and battery whose initial battery state is the target; it uses no property of E. The converse (GB1, GB5, GB9) is three lines of additivity and monotonicity. The operation class is defined through E (GB0), so each admissible E gives its own theory.

findings.title: Free set and order reversal (elementary corollaries, not claimed as new)
findings.text: GB19: the free states of the theory are the zero set of E — SEP for E_sq, all PPT states for E_N. GB20: E_sq and E_N order the pair (PPT entangled state, weakly entangled pure state) oppositely.

nodes.title: Hyperon-pair spin state

nodes.definition: (g/cos θ_W) Z_μ J^μ_NC.

nodes.title: Quantum theory
nodes.definition: Complex quantum theory.

nodes.title: Classical probability (simplex)
nodes.definition: Simplicial state space with all response functions.

nodes.title: Decay polarimeter
nodes.definition: The measurement a decay implements on the parent spin: one fixed SU(2)-covariant POVM E_w(q) = (d/4π) R_q D_w R_q† with kernel w (helicity weights of the recorded direction).

nodes.title: Spin-1/2 polarimeter
nodes.definition: E(q) = (1 + κ q.σ)/4π; κ is the spin analysing power.

nodes.title: Spin-1 polarimeter
nodes.definition: Kernel (w+, w₀, w-); η₁ = w+ - w-, η₂ = 1 - 3 w₀.

nodes.title: Recorded-outcome hidden-variable model
nodes.definition: Local hidden-variable model of single-setting data whose hidden variables are the recorded outcomes (Kasday; Abel-Dittmar-Dreiner).

nodes.title: Noncontextual ontological model
nodes.definition: Finite ontic set, convex-linear epistemic states and response functions that respect all operational equivalences of the fragment (simplex embedding).

nodes.title: Mutual tomographic completeness
nodes.definition: The accessible states and effects span each other's dual space; operational equivalences are then those read off the data.

nodes.title: Parity-violating decay asymmetries
nodes.definition: Angular asymmetries in weak decays (60Co, muon decay).

nodes.title: Decay-angle distribution
nodes.definition: p(q) = Tr[ρ E_w(q)] of one particle; multipole coefficients.

nodes.title: Joint decay-angle distribution
nodes.definition: (4π)² p(qA,qB) = 1 + a.qA + b.qB + qAᵀ c qB; raw coefficients (a, b, c).

nodes.title: Opening-angle coefficient D

nodes.title: Raw-PPT test

nodes.title: Noncontextuality inequalities / simplex-embedding LP

nodes.title: Entanglement witness / PPT

nodes.title: Spin-1 region test
nodes.definition: (η₁, η₂) outside R (all states) or the product of ratios outside R₂ (pair, one decay each).

nodes.title: Vector analysing power bound
nodes.definition: |κ₁| > ξ₂ⱼ with ξ_n the largest Gauss (n even) or Gauss-Radau (n odd) node.

nodes.title: Generalized contextuality

nodes.title: Bell inequality violation
nodes.definition: No local hidden-variable model of a multi-setting behaviour.

nodes.title: EPR steering
nodes.definition: No local hidden-state model of an assemblage.
